product_family: Magnific is a comprehensive AI creative platform offering image generation, upscaling (up to 16x), video generation, audio tools, and commercial-licensed access to 250M+ stock assets. Available in tiered subscription models from Essential ($5.75/mo) to Business/Enterprise plans with admin controls and SSO.

privacy.ai_training_note: Magnific explicitly states: 'Under no circumstances will we use your images or voices, or those of third parties that you upload to our platform, to train or improve our artificial intelligence models or those of third-party providers.' However, third-party AI model providers may retain uploaded data for a maximum of 30 days after output generation.
privacy.data_region: EU (Standard Contractual Clauses for international transfers). Users can select which AI models to use based on data processing location preference.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: SAML 2.0 SSO with configurable enforcement modes available on Enterprise plan

security.name: Data Protection
security.value: Information Security Policy ensures confidentiality, integrity, and availability of company and customer information. Applies to all employees, contractors, suppliers, and third parties with data access.

security.name: AI Model Training
security.value: Customer data is never used to train or fine-tune AI models

security.name: Data Transfer Compliance
security.value: Uses Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) with third-party model providers for GDPR-compliant international transfers

security.name: Incident Reporting
security.value: Procedures established for reporting security incidents and vulnerabilities

security.name: Legal Protection
security.value: Legal indemnification against third-party IP claims available on Enterprise plan for both stock and AI-generated content

products.name: Essential Plan
products.data_scope: Personal/Commercial use. Access to image generation, upscaling, video, audio tools, and 250M+ stock library.
products.notes: Starting at €5.75/month. Includes commercial AI license.

products.name: Premium+ Plan
products.data_scope: Personal/Commercial use. Enhanced features including higher monthly credits.
products.notes: Starting at €24.50/month. Full access to all AI models and pro editing tools.

products.name: Business Plan
products.data_scope: Team collaboration with admin controls. All features plus team workspace management.
products.notes: Custom pricing. Includes team admin dashboard and role-based access control.

products.name: Enterprise Plan
products.data_scope: Large-scale organizational deployment with full compliance controls.
products.notes: Custom pricing. Includes SAML 2.0 SSO, custom agreements, legal indemnification, dedicated support. SOC 2 Type I, ISO 27001, ISO 22301, GDPR certified.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with tiered subscriptions: Essential (€5.75/mo), Premium+ (€24.50/mo), Business (custom), Enterprise (custom). Free tier includes limited access to stock library and basic tools.
compare.data_residency: EU (with option to select specific AI model providers). Standard Contractual Clauses for international transfers. Users can configure data processing location.

flags: SOC 2 certification is Type I (point-in-time audit) rather than Type II (effectiveness over time). Type I is still valid but indicates a single-point-in-time assessment rather than sustained control effectiveness testing.
Product is consumer-focused AI creative tool, not targeted at healthcare/HIPAA-regulated industries, so HIPAA absence is appropriate.
Trust center exists (trust.magnific.com) but full content was not fully accessible during verification; however, official enterprise plan documentation provides sufficient compliance details.
